correctness.after: One binding scope policy and one source-traceability matrix define the active objective, acceptance gates, evidence status and exclusions.

reproducibility.after: The application worksheet and final dossier are mapped to source sections, testable outputs, current evidence and blockers.

reliability.before: A web-only decision conflicted with the owner's current Windows-installable handover requirement.
reliability.after: The current policy supersedes the old web-only decision and requires clean-Windows installation, execution, workflow and Park handover.

scientific_validity.after: README and acceptance matrix mark the original artifact UNKNOWN/BLOCKED until recovery and independent authentication. This documentation change does not validate the model.

measurement.trade_off: The change adds governance and traceability. It does not implement missing product features, recover the model artifact, acquire the Park dataset, or establish scientific validation.
